name: communication
summary: Agents write in your voice, give short updates, and share plans and previews as links.
day: Agents draft messages, pull request descriptions, and docs the way you write them. Plans and running apps reach other people as links.
cost: It spends no extra usage beyond the drafts you ask for.
risk: Shared plans are secret gists. Anyone with the link can read them.

workflows.name: Your voice
workflows.sentence: Agents write messages, pull request descriptions, and docs in your voice, from a skill you own.

workflows.name: Updates and shared plans
workflows.sentence: Agents give updates with the outcome first, and share plans and reports as one link. Type /explain-diff to have a change explained.

workflows.name: Previews
workflows.sentence: A running app or UI change on your devbox opens as a private link on any of your devices.
